title: Silver futures decline to ₹1.85 lakh per kg - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
In New York, silver was trading 2.59 per cent down at $50.80 per ounce | Photo Credit: MicroStockHub

Silver prices fell by ₹4,153 to ₹1,85,300 per kilogram in futures trade on Friday as participants reduced their bets.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, silver contracts for December delivery declined by ₹4,153, or 2.19 per cent, to ₹1,85,300 per kg in a business turnover of 3,944 lots.

Analysts said a sell-off by participants mainly weighed on silver prices.

Globally, the white metal was trading 2.59 per cent down at $50.80 per ounce in New York.
